name: local-first-tools
description: A set of lightweight, open-source tools for building fast and efficient local-first applications.
rationale: The current market lacks a comprehensive suite of local-first tools that can handle complex performance monitoring tasks. Building such a tool now is valuable due to the growing demand for fast and efficient development workflows.
goals: Build a simple, easy-to-use performance monitoring tool
Improve the overall developer experience with local-first applications
test_criteria: All unit tests must pass (pytest exit 0)
No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
